score_meaning: p_jamming and p_spoofing are model scores, calibrated (isotonic) against the system's own training labels (weak rules and simulated attacks) on its validation day: of cells scored 0.8, about 8 in 10 carried those labels in testing. They are not validated probabilities of real interference. The label uses the uncalibrated score at the threshold given.
